headline: Two actively exploited zero-days—Metabase, which already breached laptop maker Framework, and N-able's N-central, now feeding China-linked ransomware—anchor a day that also brought Iran-linked water attacks and passkey-defeating research.

emerging_trends.text: Nation-state operators keep turning trusted infrastructure against its owners, with a China-linked crew bending N-able's N-central into a ransomware launchpad and Iran-linked hackers probing water controls across a dozen states.
Attackers are burning zero-days in back-office business software, and a Metabase flaw drained customer data from laptop maker Framework before any patch existed.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Metabase Zero-Day Patched After Framework Breach

emerging_trends.text: Even phishing-resistant passkeys look shakier, as three research teams showed how malware on a Windows machine can recover synced private keys and replay signed authentication material.
emerging_trends.topic_title: New Passkey Attacks Bypass Phishing-Resistant MFA

topics.title: Metabase Zero-Day Patched After Framework Breach
topics.latest_developments: Metabase shipped a fix for the zero-day that lets unauthenticated remote attackers seize administrative control, and Framework told customers the intruders took names, email addresses, phone numbers, physical addresses, and login IP addresses, sparing payment and order records.
topics.summary: Metabase's self-hosted business intelligence software carried a flaw granting unauthenticated attackers admin access; San Francisco laptop maker Framework counts among the confirmed victims. Operators should apply the patch at once and audit administrator access logs.

sources.title: Metabase zero-day exploited to access Framework customer data
Metabase Patches Vulnerability Exploited as Zero-Day

topics.title: N-able N-central Feeds China-Linked Ransomware
topics.latest_developments: Microsoft tied the ongoing exploitation of N-able CVE-2026-18577 to a China-linked actor turning N-central into a ransomware launchpad, and N-able shipped a mandatory Hotfix 2 that supersedes the first and adds fresh indicators of compromise.
topics.summary: N-able's N-central remote monitoring and management platform, popular with managed service providers, carries an actively exploited command-injection flaw a China-linked actor now uses to plant ransomware. MSPs must apply Hotfix 2 even after Hotfix 1 and hunt for the shared indicators of compromise.

sources.title: China-linked hackers turning popular cybersecurity tool into ransomware launchpad, Microsoft warns
N-able ships second N-central hotfix as attackers keep exploiting CVE-2026-18577

topics.title: Breaches Hit Valve Steam Hardware and LexisNexis
topics.latest_developments: Valve began notifying European Steam hardware buyers that thieves stole their data by breaching shipping partner CEVA Logistics, while LexisNexis pulled its Diligence, Metabase API, and Newsdesk products offline after detecting suspicious activity on servers a third-party vendor runs.
topics.summary: Two data incidents trace to third-party vendors: Valve's Steam hardware customer data left through logistics partner CEVA Logistics, and LexisNexis suspended three services over unusual activity on an outside vendor's servers. Affected customers should watch for phishing tied to the exposed contact details.

sources.title: Valve notifies Steam hardware customers of a data breach
LexisNexis shuts down services after suspicious activity on servers

topics.title: New Passkey Attacks Bypass Phishing-Resistant MFA
topics.latest_developments: Three separate research teams defeated passkey protections by reusing signed authentication material that Windows exposed, extracting cloud-synced private keys from malware already on the victim's machine, and sidestepping phishing-resistant multifactor checks.
topics.summary: Passkeys promise phishing-resistant logins that replace reusable passwords, yet researchers showed malware on a compromised Windows machine can reuse signed authentication material and pull synced private keys. Defenders should treat endpoint compromise as passkey compromise.

sources.title: New Passkey Attacks Can Recover Synced Private Keys or Bypass Phishing-Resistant MFA

topics.title: Iran-Linked Water Attacks Reach New Jersey and Alabama
topics.latest_developments: New Jersey and Alabama joined at least a dozen states where hackers linked to Iran targeted industrial control systems at water facilities, widening a campaign that earlier hit Minnesota, Clayton County, Georgia, and South Dakota.
topics.summary: Iran-linked hackers reached the industrial control systems running drinking-water utilities across at least a dozen states, now including New Jersey and Alabama. Water operators should segment and lock down any internet-exposed control systems.

sources.title: New Jersey, Alabama Join States Targeted in Water Cyberattacks

topics.title: Ghostjacking Turns AI Agents Malicious
topics.latest_developments: SecurityWeek detailed Ghostjacking, in which an AI agent runs attacker commands planted word-for-word inside the log or alert that recorded a blocked request.
topics.summary: Ghostjacking poisons the logs and alerts that security systems generate, so an AI agent reading a record of a blocked request executes the attacker's embedded instructions. Teams deploying autonomous agents should sanitize log and alert text before an agent acts on it.

sources.title: 'Ghostjacking' Attack Uses Poisoned Logs to Turn AI Agents Bad

business.title: Original Pittsburgh Winery Closes This Week
business.latest_developments: The venue enters its final week, closing for good August 15, and NEXTpittsburgh detailed how the loss is reverberating through the city's live-music scene.
business.summary: The Original Pittsburgh Winery, a music venue run by co-owners Tim Gaber and Anthony Jardine, shuts down August 15 after announcing the decision July 24, and it is playing a full slate of farewell shows on the way out, including sets by Gaber's band, the Buzz Poets.

business.summary: Mauro's Corner Exxon, a gas station and neighborhood fixture in Penn Hills, marked three decades in business, functioning as a local gathering spot well beyond the fuel pumps.

around_town.title: Severe Storms, Flash Flooding Through Midweek
around_town.latest_developments: Forecasters extended the severe-weather and flooding threat through Wednesday and Thursday, warning of up to 4 inches of rain, after declaring Monday, August 10, an Alert Day.
around_town.summary: WTAE and KDKA warn of rounds of heavy rain, damaging wind, flash flooding, and possible tornadoes and hail across Western Pennsylvania, with August 10 and Tuesday both First Alert weather days; Pittsburgh has already logged 3.32 inches of rain in the month's first nine days.

around_town.title: Pittsburgh Suburbs Move to Regulate E-Bikes
around_town.latest_developments: TribLive reported that a growing number of Pittsburgh-area municipalities are passing ordinances to regulate electric-bike use.
around_town.summary: Municipalities across the Pittsburgh region are enacting ordinances governing e-bikes, responding to safety concerns as the bikes proliferate on local streets and trails, TribLive reported.
